# npc-showcase-clips

Record short clips of NPC conversations that look like real gameplay, ready to post: script an exchange at a chosen place and time (or pin an approved line with say:/do:), hold the gameplay camera still behind the player, render both lines before the clip rolls so they play back to back, keep only the game's own HUD and subtitles on screen, sync screen and audio with a flash, a beep and timeline markers, and cut 5-10 s clips in 16:9 (and 9:16), re-taking any clip that runs long instead of cutting words — and before posting, the human decides and says the cloned voices are AI.
